paragraphs: Okay, friend, here's the big idea. The LORD doesn't just announce what's coming for Babylon. He turns to His own people and says, "Come out of her, My people! Save your lives, each of you, from the fierce anger of the LORD." (Jeremiah 51:45) God cares about what happens to His people when the big stuff comes down. He gives them a way out, and He tells them to take it.

And take it NOW, because He says, "You who have escaped the sword, depart and do not linger!" (Jeremiah 51:50) He also tells them not to be afraid when the rumors roll in (Jeremiah 51:46), and I know that feeling, when every headline says the sky is falling. But the LORD says the destroyers will come even if Babylon "ascends to the heavens and fortifies her lofty stronghold" (Jeremiah 51:53), so no fortress is bigger than His word. The LORD of Hosts, the King, says her thick walls will be leveled and the people's labor will be for nothing (Jeremiah 51:57-58).

So what does that mean for you, baker? The LORD told His people to leave Babylon and not linger, so when He speaks, listen and move. He also told them to remember Him and keep Jerusalem on their minds (Jeremiah 51:50), so when the world gets loud, trust the King who named Himself the LORD of Hosts. This story isn't over, and I'm keeping my ovens ready!
